* LoggingMiddleware takes a level name; export SharedMetricsMiddleware (#17)

  that logger.log rejected on every hook); an unknown name is refused at
  construction. create_observability_middleware no longer converts the level
  itself, nor silently falls back to INFO for an unknown name.
- SharedMetricsMiddleware, the one to count across processes with the
  default backend, is exported from au.

  lowercase level resolves; the ValueError quotes the caller's value; a level
  that is neither int nor str is a TypeError at construction.
- Tests: custom level, both refusals, create_observability_middleware's
  level reaching LoggingMiddleware; the docstring shows the name form.
